categories.main_business_segments: Taiyen Industrial Corp operates primarily in salt products, packaged drinking water, beauty and personal care products, cleaning products, health foods, and related biotechnology sectors. The company also engages in medical devices, pet foods, and leisure services such as amusement parks and restaurants. Its business spans manufacturing, retail, and international trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ion-exchange membrane electrodialysis technology for salt production, ensuring high purity and safety. It employs fermentation technology for bioactive ingredients in health and beauty products. Key innovations include nano-scale collagen encapsulation and natural UV-absorbing compounds for cosmetics. Production processes emphasize automation, quality control, and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taiyen serves a broad customer base including food processing industries, agriculture, fisheries, general consumers for packaged water and personal care products, health-conscious individuals for supplements, and pet owners. Its products are distributed through supermarkets, drugstores, e-commerce platforms, and direct retail outlets. The company also targets international markets, especially in China and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan, Miaoli, and Chiayi. It exports products to Mainland China and Southeast Asian countries, leveraging government policies for market expansion. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 97% of revenue, with growing international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taiyen operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing finished salt, water, cosmetics, and health products. It sources raw materials globally, including salt from Australia and other countries, and supplies finished goods to retailers and end consumers. The company also engages in contract manufacturing and brand licensing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on marine biotechnology and innovation in collagen and natural bioactive ingredients. R&D priorities include developing functional health foods, sustainable cosmetics with natural ingredients, and advanced packaging water products. It emphasizes product safety, efficacy, and environmental sustainability, with ongoing patent applications and international certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales across multiple categories: salt products, packaged water, cosmetics, cleaning products, and health supplements. Sales channels include wholesale to food processors, retail through chain stores and e-commerce, and international exports. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing and licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taiyen holds a leading position in Taiwan’s salt and alkaline ionized water markets, with estimated market shares of approximately 70-80% in salt and over 15% in packaged water. The cosmetics and health food segments are highly competitive with many domestic and international brands. Taiyen differentiates through technology, quality, and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.24 billion with a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$371.5 million, representing a 23.7% increase year-over-year. The company maintains a stable financial structure with strong liquidity ratios and steady growth in profitability. R&D expenses are significant, supporting ongoing innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taiyen emphasizes product safety, high quality, and innovation rooted in marine biotechnology. Its salt products are produced with advanced electrodialysis technology ensuring purity and safety. Packaged water is marketed as functional alkaline ionized water with health benefits. Beauty and health products leverage patented collagen and natural extracts, with a strong focus on sustainability and environmental responsibility.
